set.body: Goal: keep PlotCompiler.compile/resolve as the facade but factor internals into explicit phases: mapping resolution, scale resolution, row evaluation, geom lowering, guide resolution, and scene assembly. Acceptance: phase types are inspectable and testable; compiler behavior stays compatible; row diagnostics and resolved layer metadata survive the refactor; focused JVM/JS graphics and SVG tests pass.
set.title: Graphics: split PlotCompiler into explicit phases
